who: Historian of Africa at the University of Minnesota; PhD in history, Minnesota, 1999.

Minnesota records her history PhD in June 1999 and names her as adviser for Janeke Thumbran (2019), Virgil Slade (2021), and co-adviser for Abraham Seda (2023).
Lists Helena Pohlandt-McCormick as associate professor in History, specializing in African history.

notes: Exact degree and direct student-adviser matches identify the LC-only candidate. Minnesota records Slade in 2021 rather than the supplied 2020.
